caseName: Houston & Texas Central Railroad v. Bowles
caseNameFull: Houston and Texas Central Railroad Company v. Bowles and Houston and Texas Central Railroad Company v. Strycharski
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the State- of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. R. S. Lovett and Mr. Maxwell Evarts for plaintiffs in error., Mr. II. M. Gar-wood for defendants in error in No. 92., Mr. Presley K. Ewing and Mr. II. F. Ring for defendants in error in No. 284.

opinions.text:
Per Guriam.

Judgments affirmed with costs and interest on the authority of Pennsylvania Railroad v. Jones, 155 U. S. 333, 350; Railroad Company v. Brown, 17 Wall. 445, 450; Texas & Pacific Railway v. Johnson, 151 U. S. 81; Texas & Pacific Railway v. Bloom’s Administrator, 164 U. S. 636.
